text: DSH Chat Image Lightbox 是面向 DSH Web 对话的图片查看与整理插件。它将灯箱浏览、图片网格控制和图片服务接入聊天界面，并注册 display_image 工具处理本地图片、网络图片或关键词搜图。用户可以放大和拖动查看原图、翻页、下载图片，也能把会话图片切成可调列数的缩略图或暂时隐藏。它还为 TIFF 和 HEIC 提供服务端转码显示，并能把图片搜索结果保存到本地。适合需要在 DSH 对话中检查、整理或展示图片的用户；需要宿主提供 webServer，TIFF/HEIC 转码需 sharp。

DSH Chat Image Lightbox adds image viewing to DSH chats. Its display_image tool accepts paths, image URLs, or search terms. Users can zoom, pan, navigate, and download images, arrange them in an adjustable grid, or hide and restore them. TIFF and HEIC display uses sharp transcoding.

Find images by keyword and show them in a chat.
DSH Chat Image Lightbox 的功能「全屏灯箱」：点击对话图片可在全屏查看原图，通过滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、方向操作或触屏滑动浏览，并可下载。
DSH Chat Image Lightbox 的功能「会话缩略图网格」：点击对话图显控制可将图片排成缩略图网格，并调整每行列数；列数会保存在浏览器本地。
DSH Chat Image Lightbox 的功能「隐藏会话图片」：通过对话图显控制可隐藏图片并在之后恢复，界面操作由客户端按图片区块更新。
DSH Chat Image Lightbox 的功能「图片投递与格式处理」：display_image 工具接收本地路径、图片直链或搜索词，生成对话可用图片链接；服务端可将 TIFF/HEIC 转码供浏览器显示。
DSH Chat Image Lightbox 会在本机通过 webServer 提供图片和图库 API；客户端调试通道可向本机日志追加记录。
DSH Chat Image Lightbox 的灯箱列数设置保存在浏览器 localStorage；TIFF/HEIC 显示转码依赖 sharp。

>
> **实测事故（2026-10-21）**：插件 20 张图（10 种格式）全部交付成功，但模型把图全留在 `display_image` 的工具结果里，
> 正文只写了一张格式对照表 → 用户回「一张没看见啊」。原因是 1.7.8~1.8.8 的铁律只写了「不得只依赖工具行」，
> 可以被「正文写了字但没写图」绕过。
>
> 1.8.9 起铁律升级为 6 条硬约束 + 1 条收尾自检：**必须把工具返回的 `` 原样复述进正文**、
> **表格/结论/清单都不算图**、**发前数一遍正文里 ` · 排查见 [⑥ 发图失败](#发图片时提示-sessionagent-busy-errdlopenfailed175-已修复) 与 [Troubleshooting ⑥](#sending-an-image-fails-with-sessionagent-busy-errdlopenfailed-fixed-in-175)。
>

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · Usage：> ⚠️ **Do not hand-build `/images/?abs=…`.** That is the legacy 1.7.x shape. On Desktop (page origin `dsh-app://app`) > `parseFileLink` returns `undefined` for any destination containing `?`, and `localPathMediaUrl` strips `?abs=` via > `split(/[?#]/)`, leaving `dsh-app://app/api/file?path=%2Fimages%2F` — a *directory* — which answers > `FS_NOT_REGULAR_FILE` + 403 and renders as "failed · filename". The body builder shipped in 1.7.9 on GitHub uses > exactly that shape, **which is why it renders nothing on Desktop — do not treat it as a reference implementation**. > > ⚠️ **Never use `http://127.0.0.1:/images/...` either.** DSH Desktop renders the GUI inside the custom protocol > `dsh-app://app`, so the loopback `http://` origin is a *different* origin: Chromium blocks it in the renderer before the > request ever reaches the web server (`fetch` throws `TypeError: Failed to fetch`, `` fires `onerror`).
section: Usage

dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ② Blank image / empty lightbox = hotlink protection on the image host (source limit, not this plugin)：- No normal webpage can hotlink these directly (including all sites except Weibo) — this is not something any plugin can fix.
- **Workaround**: download the image to `~/.dsh/uploads/` (fetch with a proper `Referer`, or just save it from the browser), then serve it via `/images/`.

Example — fetching a hotlink-protected image (Windows):
```
curl -e "https://weibo.com" -o image.jpg "https://wx1.sinaimg.cn/.../xxx.jpg"
```

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)：**Why it happened**: the DSH kernel ships `sharp ^0.35.3`, while older versions of this plugin **pinned sharp to exactly `0.34.4`** — putting two different sharp builds into one process. They load a DLL with the **same filename** (`libvips-42.dll`) but need different companions (`libvips-cpp-8.17.2.dll` for 0.34.x vs `libvips-cpp-8.18.3.dll` for 0.35.x). **Windows resolves DLLs by filename**, so whichever loads first claims the name and the other fails with "the specified procedure could not be found".
section: ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)

text:
dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)：The trailing `agent-busy` is a generic wrapper the kernel applies to **unclassified errors** — it has nothing to do with actual concurrency, which is why the real cause is hard to spot from the message alone.

> Note: this only ever affected **sending images**; plain text chat was never impacted.
section: ⑥ Sending an image fails with `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` (fixed in 1.7.5)

text:
dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order：| Log line | What its absence means |
|---|---|
| `image-gallery: serving from ... (sharp: available)` | The plugin is not loaded at all (see item 3) |
| `image-gallery: image delivery law registered (order 1500, ... chars)` | The `systemPrompt` service is unavailable → the plugin warns `delivery law skipped`. **The delivery law is then not in the system prompt, so the model will likely leave images in the tool row where you cannot see them** |
| `image-gallery: display_image tool registered` | The `tools` service or `defineTool` is unavailable → the plugin warns `display_image tool skipped`. **There is no tool to call** |
section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order：**2. `(sharp: unavailable)` is not the cause of "no images".** It only affects TIFF/HEIC (they render as "image cannot be previewed"); JPG/PNG/WEBP are fine. Root cause: after a junction install, Node resolves from the plugin's real path and cannot find `profiles/<name>/node_modules` (where sharp lives — a sibling branch, not an ancestor). The plugin already resolves against multiple roots as a fallback.

Check these in order：With only the first two, **the host skips the package silently: no warning, no error, the plugin behaves as if it does not exist**. Check with `Test-Path <profile>/node_modules/dsh-chat-image-lightbox`.
section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order：**4. After changing client code, fully exit the process before restarting.** With `closeToTray: true`, clicking the window's × only hides it to the system tray — the process keeps running, and host plugins load at boot with no hot reload, so this is not a restart. `Ctrl+R` does not reload client bundles either. Correct way: tray icon → right click → Quit, wait for the process to disappear, then start again.
section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order：**5. Do not chase `dsh.client.inject`.** A wrong package name there is **silently ignored** (the host simply does not schedule an `inject` entry it cannot resolve, and reports nothing); only `external` fails hard. So a bad `inject` entry cannot cause "no images".
section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order：**6. A 403 `Browser access is disabled` from a plain browser or curl on `/images/?abs=...` is expected.** The desktop app defaults to `browserAccess: false` and only admits requests carrying the Electron renderer token. Viewing images inside the desktop client is unaffected.
section: ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ Installed the plugin but still see no images? Check these in order：> **The most important point**: if everything above is green and all three log lines are present, yet the assistant's message body still has only text — **that is not a plugin fault, it is the model not following the image delivery law**. DSH's host only auto-promotes results of the built-in `read_image` tool (source: `imageCardModel` contains `if (call?.name !== "read_image") return null;`); results from third-party tools always fold into the tool row, and the tool row is **collapsed by default**. So a third-party plugin can only deliver images by **writing the markdown image into the reply body**. That constraint is enforced by the system-prompt section the plugin registers — if that log line is missing, the constraint is not there.

dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · Requirements：- **DSH kernel** — the package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-0 <0.3.0"` (and the same range in `peerDependencies`). The upper bound is deliberate: `peerDependencies` is a **runtime gate** — the host checks it before importing the plugin and silently disables the row on mismatch, so an open-ended range would let a future breaking generation install "successfully" and then fail quietly. This release was verified end to end on **DSH NEXT 2.0.19-next** (kernel `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`). The client half relies on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool` being injectable (measured `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- Host must expose the `webServer` service (standard in DSH Desktop).
- Node.js ≥ 22
- `sharp` `^0.35.3` (declared as a dependency; it is what performs the lossless TIFF/HEIC transcoding). The range follows the DSH kernel's own `^0.35.3` — an exact pin here would put two different sharp builds into one process and break image sending (see Troubleshooting).
- **Windows note**: "show in folder" uses `explorer /select,`

dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑥ 发图片时提示 `session/agent-busy` / `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`（1.7.5 已修复）：**为什么会这样**：DSH 内核自带 `sharp ^0.35.3`，而旧版本把本插件的 sharp **精确锁定在 0.34.4**，于是同一个进程里出现了两个不同版本的 sharp。它们加载的 DLL **同名**（都叫 `libvips-42.dll`），但各自需要不同的配套文件（0.34.x 要 `libvips-cpp-8.17.2.dll`，0.35.x 要 `libvips-cpp-8.18.3.dll`）。**Windows 按文件名解析 DLL**——谁先加载谁占住，后来者就报"找不到指定的过程"。

报错末尾的 `agent-busy`（会话忙）是 DSH 对**无法分类的错误**套用的通用标签，与实际是否繁忙无关，因此很难一眼看出真因。

> 注：此问题只影响**发图片**，纯文字对话始终正常。

**4. 改了客户端代码必须「完全退出进程」再启动。** `closeToTray: true` 时点窗口右上角 × 只是收进系统托盘，进程并不退出，宿主插件是 boot 装载不热重载 → 等于没重启。`Ctrl+R` 刷新页面也不重载客户端 bundle。正解：托盘图标右键 → 退出，等进程消失后再启动。

**5. 不要往 `dsh.client.inject` 方向排查。** 里面写错包名是**静默无效**的（宿主对 inject 里查不到的包只是不排队，不报错）；只有 `external` 写错才会硬失败。所以 inject 写错不会导致「不显示」。

text:
dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）：**6. 用浏览器或 curl 直接访问 `/images/?abs=...` 拿到 403 `Browser access is disabled`，这是预期行为。** 桌面端默认 `browserAccess: false`，只放行带 Electron 渲染器令牌的请求。你在桌面客户端界面里看图不受影响。

> **最重要的一条**：如果以上全绿、日志三条齐全，但 AI 发图时正文里仍然只有文字——那**不是插件故障**，是 AI 没遵守「图片投递铁律」。DSH 宿主只给内置的 `read_image` 工具自动出图（源码里 `imageCardModel` 有 `if (call?.name !== "read_image") return null;` 的白名单），第三方工具的结果一律被折进工具行，而工具行**默认是收起的**。所以第三方插件发图，**只能靠把 markdown 图片写进回复正文**。这条约束由插件注册的 system prompt 段强制执行；若那条日志缺失，约束就不在。
section: ⑦ 装了插件还是看不到图？按这个顺序查（安装侧排查）

dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · 键盘与鼠标：| 操作 | 输入 |
|------|------|
| 打开 lightbox | 点击图片 |
| 放大 / 缩小 | 点击图片，或放大后滚动滚轮 |
| 平移 | 放大后按住拖拽 |
| 上一张 / 下一张 | `←` / `→` 方向键、屏幕箭头、或滑动 |
| 关闭 | `Esc`、点击遮罩层、或 ✕ |

text:
dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · HTTP 接口：| 接口 | 方法 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `/images/<path>` | GET | 提供上传图片（仅本机回环，带扩展名/安全校验） |
| `/api/image-gallery/list` | GET | 列出图库根目录下图片，支持 `?limit=N` |
| `/api/image-gallery/root` | GET | 返回配置的图库根目录路径 |
| `/api/image-gallery/reveal` | POST | 在系统文件管理器（资源管理器 / Finder）中定位并选中某个文件 |
| `/api/image-gallery/diag` | POST | 向 `~/.dsh/image-gallery-diag.log` 追加一行（客户端调试通道；`IG_DEBUG` 关闭时无实际写入） |
section: HTTP 接口

text: dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · 工作原理：| 组件 | 说明 | |------|------| | **Host** (`lib/index.js`) | 在 `ctx.webServer` 上注册 `/images/` 文件服务路由 + 4 条 `/api/image-gallery/*` 精确路由（`list`、`root`、`reveal`、`diag`） | | **Client** (`lib/client.js`) | 用 `MutationObserver` 监听对话中的 `` 元素，添加展示样式与点击处理器打开 lightbox（只加 class，不改 DOM 结构） |
section: 工作原理

text:
dsh-chat-image-lightbox README · 环境要求：- **DSH 内核** —— 本包声明 `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-0 <0.3.0"`（`peerDependencies` 同区间）。上界是刻意的：`peerDependencies` 是**运行时门禁**——宿主在 import 插件**之前**校验，不匹配就直接禁用该行且模块永不导入，所以开区间上界会让将来某个破坏性世代「装上看似正常、然后静默失效」。本版实测验证于 **DSH NEXT 2.0.19-next**（内核 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`）。浏览器端依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool` 可被注入（实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。
- 宿主需提供 `webServer` 服务（DSH 桌面端标准配置）。
- Node.js ≥ 22
- `sharp` `^0.35.3`（已声明为依赖，TIFF/HEIC 的无损转码由它完成）。采用区间跟随 DSH 内核自身的 `^0.35.3`——若在此精确锁版，会让两个不同 sharp 版本共存于同一进程，导致**发图失败**（见「图片显示常见问题排查」）。
- **Windows 说明**：「在文件夹中显示」使用 `explorer /select,`
section: 环境要求
